listings.description: Join us in building the AI layer for Observability! ClickStack is the open-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse — logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in. We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers — and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work — we'd like to talk. What you'll do Build agents that investigate incidents. They surface anomalies, answer "why is production broken?", and use ClickStack as their substrate. Write skills, not just prompts. Build a library of reusable skills that captures how our team debugs, finds root causes, writes ClickHouse queries, and runs incident response, so agents pick up the right playbook instead of starting from scratch. Own the agent stack end-to-end. Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production. Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads. Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves. Work in the open. Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product. Tackle the hard parts. Latency, cost, context window limits, eval coverage, hallucinations on real telemetry. listings.description:
Mission Brief 

You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward.

As a Senior Structural Analysis Engineer you will play a major role in improving our overall analysis and verification workflow by defining standards, sharing technical knowledge and reviewing your colleagues’ results and identifying action points. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures 
  • Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. 
  • Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. </

listings.title: Senior Mechanism Engineer, LV Structures
listings.description:
Mission Brief 

You will need strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders, direct reports and leaders within and outside the organization. You will be part of a team responsible for developing stage separation mechanisms, fairing separation mechanisms, hydraulic, pneumatic and electro-mechanical actuators and umbilical fluid and electrical systems. You have mechanical and integrated design experience as well as proven track record of delivering results on time and quality, while completing collaborative projects effectively. Your design, analysis and manufacturing skills enable you to own the outcomes of key mechanism design trades and development of our Spectrum Launch Vehicle.  

Your Role in Our Space Mission:  

  • Design of the vehicle mechanisms through design phases (CAD, drawings, sizing) until qualification and acceptance. 
  • Requirements definition for vehicle mechanisms 
  • Driving trade studies, manufacturing optimization and performance for mechanisms 
  • Interface with teams in static structures and propulsion, AGNC, AIT, production 
  • Creating, reviewing and releasing development and flight hardware drawings and design documentation 
  • Identifying build/test/design optimization

listings.title: Principal System Architect, Spectrum (m/f/d)
listings.description:
Mission Brief 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

As Principal System Architect for Reusability, you will lead exploration of the reusable-launcher design space and drive convergence towards a coherent vehicle architecture. Using models and analyses developed by specialist teams, you will identify the most valuable design paths, direct further investigation and make architecture decisions that balance performance, development risk, operability, lifecycle cost and profitability. 

Qualification Checklist 

  • Extensive launch-vehicle architecture experience, including direct work on rocket development programs. 
  • Demonstrated experience with reusable launch vehicles, recovery architectures or reuse-driven vehicle design. 
  • Proven ownership of multidisciplinary architecture trades and high-impact design decisions.

listings.description:
Kurz und Knapp

Du bist gerade mit deinem Studium oder deiner Ausbildung fertig, liebst die tägliche Abwechslung in der Logistik und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung als Führungskraft?

Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einem Graduate Teamlead für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in Hamburg. 
Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.

listings.title: Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d)
listings.description:
In a Nutshell

As a Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d), you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.

 

The tricks of the trade 

  • Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.
  • Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.
  • Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.
  • Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

About you

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
  • You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role

listings.title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Materials)
listings.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lo

listings.description: Germany - EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity www.3ive.ai About Us A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next car component still clicks through CAD trees, up to 7 different softwares and searches Excel sheets, Windows folders and asks whoever has been around longest. AI is about to change that fundamentally – and nobody has figured out yet what the interface for it looks like. That is why we are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: agents that work natively in 3D, sit on top of CATIA, NX, SOLIDWORKS and Creo, and learn from real-world engineering decisions. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu prends la main sur un périmètre produit à fort enjeu business. Tu décides avec la donnée. Tu mesures l'effet de tes arbitrages sur l'usage et la performance commerciale, tu construis les indicateurs qui manquent, et tu transformes une analyse en recommandation argumentée. Pas en tableau de bord de plus. Tu traduis le besoin métier en produit. Exigences fonctionnelles, user stories, critères d'acceptation, priorisation que tu assumes et que tu sais défendre. Tu interviens sur le socle SI. Tu contribues au cadrage et à l'évolution des briques applicatives concernées, en gardant la main sur le pourquoi quand tout le monde discute du comment. Tu alignes un écosystème dense. Métiers, produit, data, IT : tu fais converger des parties prenantes multiples vers des décisions cohérentes, et tu accompagnes l'adoption des solutions auprès des équipes. Tu documentes ce qui compte. Processus, décisions, dépendances, évolutions fonctionnelles : ce que tu laisses derrière toi tient sans toi. Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil. Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit. On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant

listings.title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Zurich, Switzerland
listings.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You’ll Do
